_comment: Manuals, marketing texts and screenshots of this module, for every language in ../i18n.json. Run in the module directory: vendor/bin/ps-module docs status | build. Written by Claude: docs/content/<iso>/manual.md + marketing.json + screenshots.json (captions on the framed screenshots), the 'marketing' and 'frame' blocks below and docs/content/logo-suggestion.svg (optional). Generated (do not edit): docs/screenshots, docs/framed, docs/manual, docs/marketing, docs/index.html, docs/build-manifest.json. 'ps-module docs init' adds the 'frame' block (a starting style for this module) and the captions files.

_help.shop: version: PrestaShop version of testing.json for the screenshots ('latest' = newest); install_languages: install missing languages in the test shop; configuration: {"KEY": "value"} or {"KEY": {"en": "..", "fr": ".."}} set before the screenshots; hide: extra CSS selectors to hide.
_help.screenshots: id (file name), title, area 'bo'|'fo', path (fo: '/', '/3-clothes'; bo: '@configure', '@menu:1', a Symfony route like '/modules/<name>/items' or 'index.php?controller=AdminX'), viewport 'desktop' (1440x1000)|'tablet'|'mobile' (390x844 at 3x)|{width,height}; optional: version (a version of testing.json, 'latest' or 'oldest': Hummingbird on 9.x, Classic on 8.x; default shop.version), selector (clip to an element, padding px), scroll_to (selector scrolled to the top), full_page, wait_for (selector), click (list of selectors), delay (ms), languages (only these). Use them in manual.md as ![Caption](screenshot:<id>). Addons wants at least 3 screenshots of at least 1000x1000 px per language, front office on Classic and Hummingbird and on mobile.
_help.marketing: category: one of module-dev-tools resources/addons/categories.json; price: 49.99-4999.99; benefits: 1-3 'Group › Benefit' from resources/addons/benefits.json; multistore: always 'Fully'. The texts per language are in docs/content/<iso>/marketing.json.
